answer: Practically, the chain should let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because sparrow only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, prism is enforced in the ledger: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any velvet approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
